stops.title: اتاق خواب
stops.review: carry-over: not re-checked against the new picture - empty frame, red tile, ochre wall, one fireplace
stops.quote: so as to imitate the ochre distemper favoured by church and state alike, he had his walls hung with saffron silk; to imitate the chocolate hue of the wainscoting he covered the lower area of the walls with thin strips of dark purple rosewood ... the ceiling, in turn, was hung with white holland, which mimicked plaster, but without its discordant brightness; as for the cold flagstones, he was able to imitate these by means of a carpet patterned in red squares, with whitish areas in the weave to simulate the wear of sandals and boots.

palette.wainscot: thin strips of dark purple rosewood
palette.ceiling: white holland, mimicking plaster without its discordant brightness

furniture: a narrow bedstead, a mock hermit's bed of old wrought-iron but polished, the head and foot set off with an intricate filigree of blossoming tulips entwined with vine branches taken from the balustrade of a superb staircase from some old Parisian town house
an antique prayer-stool as bedside table, the inside accommodating a chamber-pot, the outside supporting a prayer book
a church-warden's pew against the opposite wall, surmounted by a tall openwork screen and misericords carved in solid wood

Like those Japanese boxes which fit one inside the other, this room was inserted into a larger one, the original dining-room built by the architect.
